newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan Electric Power H1 profits down 56 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jordan Electric Power H1 profits down 56 percent.

text.p: Jordan Electric Power, the country's largest electricity distributor, saw net profits fall 56 percent to 678,900 dinars in the first half of 1996 compared to the same period last year.
A copy of Jordan Electric Power's half-year budget released to the Amman Financial Market showed net profits falling to 678,900 dinars against 1.54 million dinars during the same period last year.

The company's gross revenue rose to 49.97 million dinars from 44.17 million dinars. But higher prices for electricity purchased by the distributing power company from the state owned Jordan Electricty Authority cut into net profits.
The company, a blue-chip services firm, saw its total assets rise to 156.5 million dinars at end of June 1996 from 139.4 million dinars during the same period last year.
